SRC-112:R001.text: T-1493 is not closed in its current wording (an agent-run continue must leave the WAIT): that would degrade the autonomy an explicit operator /goal grants; T-1493 is re-scoped as separating persistent /goal authority from fresh cc authority

SRC-112:R002.text: machine truth distinguishes persistent operator authorization from fresh operator reauthorization, e.g. continuation_authority operator_persistent|operator_required, authority_source (the SRC or goal event that granted it), authority_until (goal_complete or a budget), safety_valve_mode checkpoint|hard_wait

SRC-112:R003.text: under an active persistent /goal (continue until goal complete) the 20-ticket valve is a checkpoint and budget boundary -- checkpoint and safety review, authority still valid, continue automatically -- not a mandatory human gate

SRC-112:R004.text: without persistent authority (an ordinary bounded run) reaching the cap is a hard WAIT that requires the operator cc

SRC-112:R005.text: saipen continue --json invoked on the BOOT route grants itself nothing: it checks the existing authority -- an active persistent /goal continues, otherwise it answers the WAIT for the operator cc
